items.title: Supply Chain Security for the Age of AI-Speed Exploits
items.description: Learn Python supply chain security as AI speeds up attacks: what the LiteLLM backdoor teaches, how to check your setup, and habits that last.
items.summary: Python supply chain security means protecting everything your project pulls in and runs, from PyPI packages to CI workflows and publishing credentials, so that a tampered release or stolen token can’t turn your own tools against you. AI-assisted analysis makes it cheaper to turn a bug fix into a working exploit, so attacks now arrive within hours of a fix, and sometimes before it.

items.summary: Let’s face it: you need to get information into and out of your programs through more than just the keyboard and console . Exchanging information through text files is a common way to share info between programs.

items.summary: You have now covered Python variables , operators, and data types in depth, and you’ve seen quite a bit of example code. Up to now, the code has consisted of short individual statements, simply assigning objects to variables or displaying values.

items.title: How I AI: Meta Muse Wonder + How Brooke Lacey is scaling video with AI
items.author: Lenny Rachitsky
items.description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
items.summary: She explains why its active focus mode made it especially strong at billing support, inbox triage, computer use, and email writing, while its prototypes and visual work consistently fell short. She also shares how Muse compares with Opus 5.5, Astra, and Fable, and why she plans to test it in a few agent workflows without letting it anywhere near her front end.

items.summary: Scene-level 3D generation has long been dominated by 2D multi-view or video diffusion models. items.summary: Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge. Existing mitigation methods mainly operate at the output level, overlooking the entanglement of grounding evidence and learned priors within fused representations.
